source.other: It seems as if sailing on the Gulf of Perl was one of our biggest mistakes. Nature was against us and drove us into a dark, wild storm. I really don’t know how many hours have passed since the waves rose higher than our boat, but still it would be suicide to go outside.

target.other: Det verkar som att segla på Pärlbukten var ett av våra största misstag. Naturen var emot oss och drog in oss i en mörk, vild storm. Jag vet verkligen inte hur många timmar som har gått sedan vågorna blev högre än vår båt, men det vore fortfarande självmord att gå ut på däck.

key: It seems as if sailing on the Gulf of Perl was one of our biggest mistakes. Nature was against us and drove us into a dark, wild storm. I really don’t know how many hours have passed since the waves rose higher than our boat, but still it would be suicide to go outside.

target.other: Bygg ett blockhus vid den röda hussymbolen på skogens östra sida, till höger om ditt tillfälliga högkvarter.

target.other: Lutius dagbok

key: Diary of Lutius

source.other: Finally, the Gods were with us!

target.other: Till sist var gudarna med oss!

key: Finally, the Gods were with us!

source.other: Tonight will be our last night on this island. Tomorrow morning we will leave, searching for a new place for our exile.

target.other: Detta kommer att bli vår sista natt på ön. I morgon bitti kommer vi att lämna den, på jakt efter en ny plats för vår landsflykt.

key: Tonight will be our last night on this island. Tomorrow morning we will leave, searching for a new place for our exile.

source.other: The Rough Sea

target.other: Den hårda sjön

key: The Rough Sea

source.other: Sire, I saw that the construction of the blockhouse was completed, so I have assigned one of my best soldiers to it to keep watch on the desert.

target.other: Ledare, jag såg att blockhusbygget är klart så jag har givit en av mina bästa soldater i uppdrag att hålla vakt mot mot öknen.

key: Sire, I saw that the construction of the blockhouse was completed, so I have assigned one of my best soldiers to it to keep watch on the desert.

source.other: Amalea comes in…

target.other: Amalea kommer in...

key: Amalea comes in…

source.other: But unfortunately the logs are useless for repairing our ship – we need to turn them into planks, which are needed by every ship and every bigger building too. So we should build a sawmill – as soon as we have enough space for this.

target.other: Olyckligtvis är stockarna oanvändbara för att reparera vårt skepp, vi behöver göra plankor av dem. Plankor behövs till alla skepp och för alla större byggnader också. Vi borde bygga ett sågverk – så snart vi får plats med det.

key: But unfortunately the logs are useless for repairing our ship – we need to turn them into planks, which are needed by every ship and every bigger building too. So we should build a sawmill – as soon as we have enough space for this.

source.other: Build two more lumberjack’s houses and a sawmill as soon as there is enough space for them.

target.other: Bygg ytterligare två skogshuggarbostäder och ett sågverk så snart det finns tillräckligt med plats för att bygga dem.

key: Build two more lumberjack’s houses and a sawmill as soon as there is enough space for them.

source.other: We landed on an unknown coast and found peaceful rest under the palm trees growing at the shore. But that is about as good as it gets. The truth is: when I woke up this morning, I saw nothing but sand around us.

target.other: Vi steg i land på en okänd kust och fick fridfull vila under palmerna som växte vid stranden. Men allt är inte bra. Sanningen är att när jag vaknade denna morgon såg jag inget annat än sand runt omkring oss.

key: We landed on an unknown coast and found peaceful rest under the palm trees growing at the shore. But that is about as good as it gets. The truth is: when I woke up this morning, I saw nothing but sand around us.

source.other: This is a good step forward. Now we can feel a bit safer and can look forward to repairing our ship.

target.other: Detta är ett bra steg framåt. Nu kan vi känna oss lite säkrare och se fram emot att reparera vårt skepp.

key: This is a good step forward. Now we can feel a bit safer and can look forward to repairing our ship.

source.other: A Foreboding

target.other: Ett varsel

key: A Foreboding

source.other: With an army of 150 men, I was assigned to patrol on our northern frontier, which lies near the Galdin Mountains in a great, beautiful and ancient forest. Soon, we met a Barbarian tribe, which at first was friendly. A few of my men even traded with them and their children came to us, to admire our clean and tidy uniforms and weapons.

target.other: Med en arme av 150 män fick jag i uppdrag att patrullera längs vår norra gräns, vilken ligger nära Galdinbergen i en storslagen, vacker och uråldrig skog. Snart mötte vi en barbarstam som till att börja med var vänlig. Några av våra män handlade till och med med dem och deras barn kom till oss för att beundra våra rena och snygga uniformer och vapen.

key: With an army of 150 men, I was assigned to patrol on our northern frontier, which lies near the Galdin Mountains in a great, beautiful and ancient forest. Soon, we met a Barbarian tribe, which at first was friendly. A few of my men even traded with them and their children came to us, to admire our clean and tidy uniforms and weapons.

source.other: Still, I saw no way that I could erase my shame without fighting against these Barbarians. So, I left Fremil by boat to find a new world and a new life for myself, somewhere in the south. Now I am sailing on the Gulf of Perl with my family, some of my friends and a few of my best warriors.

target.other: Fortfarande såg jag inget annat sätt att bli av med min skam än att slåss mot dessa barbarer, så jag lämnade Fremil med båt för att hitta en ny värld och ett nytt liv för mig själv någonstans i söder. Nu seglar jag på Pärlbukten med min familj, några av mina vänner och en handfull av mina bästa krigare.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Lutius - Diary. Gulf of Perl is a place name.
key: Still, I saw no way that I could erase my shame without fighting against these Barbarians. So, I left Fremil by boat to find a new world and a new life for myself, somewhere in the south. Now I am sailing on the Gulf of Perl with my family, some of my friends and a few of my best warriors.

source.other: I got the message that our first lumberjack has started his work today. Perhaps it would be a good idea to wait until he has cleared enough space for constructing two more lumberjack’s houses, so that we can harvest the logs faster.

target.other: Jag fick veta att vår första skogshuggare började arbeta idag. Kanske vore det bra att bygga ytterligare två skogshuggarbostäder, när han har röjt nog med plats för dem, så vi kan avverka timmer fortare.

source.other: He told me about the blockhouse. Well, I don’t think we need more blockhouses – instead, we might concentrate on other things now.

target.other: Han berättade för mig om blockhuset. Jag tror inte att vi behöver fler blockhus, istället borde vi nog koncentrera oss på andra saker nu.

key: He told me about the blockhouse. Well, I don’t think we need more blockhouses – instead, we might concentrate on other things now.

source.other: Saledus speaks with a sigh of relief…

target.other: Saledus talar med en suck av lättnad...

key: Saledus speaks with a sigh of relief…

source.other: Three weeks later, I returned to Fremil to speak with our king. He was furious at the Barbarians, yet forbade any attack on these tribes. He believed that our army was too weak to survive in a war against the Barbarians.

target.other: Tre veckor senare återvände jag till Fremil för att prata med vår kung. Han var rasande på barbarerna men förbjöd ändå alla attacker mot dessa stammar. Han trodde att vår arme var för vek för att överleva ett krig mot barbarerna.

key: Three weeks later, I returned to Fremil to speak with our king. He was furious at the Barbarians, yet forbade any attack on these tribes. He believed that our army was too weak to survive in a war against the Barbarians.

source.other: But the bad news is that our lumberjacks harvest at an incredible speed. There are almost no trees left on this island.

target.other: Den dåliga nyheten är att skogshuggaren avverkar i en otrolig hastighet. Det finns nästan inga träd kvar på denna ö.

key: But the bad news is that our lumberjacks harvest at an incredible speed. There are almost no trees left on this island.

source.other: What has become of our Empire? I really ask this question – why did my king forbid me from fighting against that monstrous Barbarian tribe, who first acted as a peaceful friend and then attacked my army in the darkest night?

target.other: Vad har hänt med vårt imperium? Jag undrar verkligen varför min kung förbjöd mig att slåss mot den ohyggliga barbarstammen, som först uppträdde som en fredlig vän och sedan anföll min armé mitt i natten?

key: What has become of our Empire? I really ask this question – why did my king forbid me from fighting against that monstrous Barbarian tribe, who first acted as a peaceful friend and then attacked my army in the darkest night?

target.other: En mörk natt

key: A Dark Night

source.other: It is absolutely clear that we need wood to repair our ship. So, I walked through the forest yesterday to look for a nice place for a lumberjack’s house and found one right south of our provisional headquarters.

target.other: Det är helt klart så att vi behöver trä för att kunna reparera vårt skepp. Jag gick genom skogen igår för att hitta en bra plats för en skogshuggarbostad och jag hittade en rakt söder om vårt tillfälliga högkvarter.

key: It is absolutely clear that we need wood to repair our ship. So, I walked through the forest yesterday to look for a nice place for a lumberjack’s house and found one right south of our provisional headquarters.

target.other: Vårt skepp är illa skadat och tar in mer och mer vatten. Vi kan tacka gudarna om vi överlever denna svarta natt med våra liv i behåll.

source.other: It really seems as if we have landed under the only palm trees existing in this far-away sandy desert. I fear we won’t find the help we need to get our ship repaired in good time.

target.other: Det verkar faktiskt som att vi landsteg under de enda palmer som finns i denna fjärran, sandiga öken. Jag fruktar att vi inte kommer att hitta den hjälp vi behöver för att reparera vårt skepp inom en rimlig framtid.

source.other: Greetings, Lutius! I just met Saledus outside.

target.other: Hallå, Lutius! Jag mötte just Saledus här utanför.

key: Greetings, Lutius! I just met Saledus outside.

source.other: Sire, today we got a lot closer to our first castle. The quarry to the south began its work today and will soon provide us with granite and beautiful marble.

target.other: Ledare, idag kom vi mycket närmare att kunna bygga vårt första slott. Stenbrottet i söder började arbeta idag och det kommer snart att förse oss med granit och vacker marmor.

key: Sire, today we got a lot closer to our first castle. The quarry to the south began its work today and will soon provide us with granite and beautiful marble.

target.other: Bygg ett skogsvaktarboställe

key: Build a forester’s house

source.other: You really should build a blockhouse in the eastern portion of the forest. Then one of my men can keep watch in the darkness and keep us safe from these creatures.

target.other: Du borde verkligen bygga ett blockhus i östra delen av skogen. Då kan en av mina män hålla vakt i mörkret och hålla oss säkra från dessa varelser.

key: You really should build a blockhouse in the eastern portion of the forest. Then one of my men can keep watch in the darkness and keep us safe from these creatures.

source.other: Sire, I fear we are not safe in this foreign land. Who knows what terrible creatures live beyond this forest, in that mighty desert? What if these creatures enter the woods and await the time to attack us?

target.other: Vår ledare, jag fruktar att vi inte är säkra i detta nya land. Vem vet vilka hemska varelser som bor bortom skogen, i den enorma öknen? Vad händer om varelserna närmar sig i skogen och väntar in rätt tidpunkt för att anfalla oss?

key: Sire, I fear we are not safe in this foreign land. Who knows what terrible creatures live beyond this forest, in that mighty desert? What if these creatures enter the woods and await the time to attack us?

source.other: Saledus speaks:

target.other: Saledus talar:

key: Saledus speaks:

source.other: Sire, I just thought about the rocks standing on the south shore of this land. Perhaps we could cut out some useful granite and beautiful marble.

target.other: Ledare, jag tänkte på klipporna som står vid öns södra strand. Kanske vi kan hugga ut användbar granit och vacker marmor ur dem?

key: Sire, I just thought about the rocks standing on the south shore of this land. Perhaps we could cut out some useful granite and beautiful marble.

source.other: But during our fifth night in that region, they attacked us with no reason. I lost dozens of good men, and found myself imprisoned and brought to their chieftain. He spat at me, mocked me and told me to leave this land forever. He did not want new land and did not want our land, but he told me that THIS forest was their land – and it would stay theirs until the spirits took the last man of his folk!

target.other: Men under vår femte natt i regionen attackerade de oss utan orsak. Jag förlorade dussintals bra män och blev själv inburad och förd till deras hövding. Han spottade på mig, hånade mig och sa till mig att lämna hans land för alltid. Han ville inte ha nytt land och han ville inte ha vårt land, men han sa till oss att denna skogen är deras land – och det skulle fortsätta vara deras tills andarna tog den sista mannen ur deras folk.

key: But during our fifth night in that region, they attacked us with no reason. I lost dozens of good men, and found myself imprisoned and brought to their chieftain. He spat at me, mocked me and told me to leave this land forever. He did not want new land and did not want our land, but he told me that THIS forest was their land – and it would stay theirs until the spirits took the last man of his folk!

source.other: These trees provide shelter from the sandstorms that sweep in from the desert, and shade on the hot days, and they are the home of many gentle animals. We shouldn’t leave this island a complete desert.

target.other: Träden ger skydd mot sandstormarna som sveper in från öknen, och skugga under varma dagar. De är också hem för många fredliga djur. Det är inte rätt att lämna hela denna ö som en öken.

key: These trees provide shelter from the sandstorms that sweep in from the desert, and shade on the hot days, and they are the home of many gentle animals. We shouldn’t leave this island a complete desert.

source.other: Today I got the message that our ship is completely repaired. At the moment, my people are loading everything onto our newly repaired ship, hoping it will serve us better than last time.

target.other: I dag fick jag besked om att vårt skepp är helt reparerat. Just nu lastar mitt folk allt ombord på vårt nyreparerade skepp i hopp om att det ska tjäna oss bättre än förra gången.

key: Today I got the message that our ship is completely repaired. At the moment, my people are loading everything onto our newly repaired ship, hoping it will serve us better than last time.

source.other: Build a forester’s house to preserve the wood resources of this island.

target.other: Bygg ett skogsvaktarboställe för att bevara öns skogstillgångar.
